language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot closes its gripper around the wooden spoon at frames 70–75 in wrist_image, then lifts and transports it toward the open drawer at frames 90–150 in image and left_ego_image. At frames 153–156, wrist_image shows the released spoon resting inside the drawer; frames 157–165 show the empty gripper withdrawing while the spoon remains there. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
